issues.description: The solution implementation declares toString() with return type Object (public Object toString()) whereas the problem statement and Java's Object.toString() contract expect a String return type. This return-type mismatch prevents the method from correctly overriding Object.toString() and will cause a compilation/error or unexpected behavior, confusing students and making the solution non-compilable.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() signature in the solution to return String (public String toString()) and ensure the method returns a String. This aligns with the problem description and Java's Object.toString() contract and makes the solution compile.
